horoscopes.horoscope: The yogis have finally succeeded in impressing you. Was it a stint in a Art of Living course? Ganesha gives you the thumbs-up and suggests you join that music or dance class you have been wanting to. Generally a nice day, and success is on the cards. Tough times on the love front may keep you worried. However, Ganesha says that this is a temporary phase so you should not let it reign your mind. If there is any issues, you will feel free to talk to your lover now, suggests Ganesha. Professional front shall be hectic, as a lot of pending task needs to be finished. This may stress and upset your mood. Ganesha foresees, that this seems a good day from your health point of view. Thus think positive and prefer to relax for some time. Today you will be concerned about your liquidity. There will be a heavy decline in your financial condition. This is going to cause you great concern. You will feel emotional insecurity. Your mind may remain in a different activity at the workplace. The pending work might be boring but your superiors want you to finish it in time. Your expectations from your superiors may be too high and they may leave you disappointed. It’s advisable to stick to the pending work today.

Armed with ingenuity and lateral thinking, you are all set to take on today with practised ease, feels Ganesha. The toughest of problems will crumble like a house of cards before your intellect. A promotion or salary hike is also likely today. Money lenders and brokers will have a profitable day, says Ganesha. A sacrificing attitude will definitely help in matters of the heart. Precisely, it is a day with its share of good and bad things. You tend to be possessive in the relationship. Ganesha says that you need to have sympathy for your loved one. Ganesha foresees that work front might draw your attention, as unfinished task needs to be completed now. Try to keep your focus on the targets. This is a good day to enroll in some physical activities, as it will keep you fit throughout. You are going to make good money today, predicts Ganesha. As planetary configurations are good, you shall be able to earn extra money through multiple channels. You shall discuss your work with lots of people. You want to bring the maximum results without any effort in the morning. You will depend on your luck today. You will be in no mood to work hard and you may stick to the smart job. Unfortunately, luck will not support you. You may want to achieve results by hook or crook.

Your long-term goals seem to be shaping up well. You may also expect some good news, which will change the course of your life. Play a waiting game in matters of auctions and sealed tenders. And memorise these words: Prevention is better than cure. You will be desperately waiting for the evening to share your emotions with that special person. Your emotional depth and sensuality will play an important role in turning on your sweetheart. Ganesha feels there will be a blissful evening and you will enjoy every moment. There will be good development in your work. This is going to impact your mood positively. As you will be able to finish your task, you will be happy. Physical health too seems good. Family front may need your attention now. You are likely to be confused today if you follow your mind, so Ganesha advises you to just follow your intuition or your emotions, especially in financial matters on which you need to take quick decisions. Today you may be dealing with people important for your organization. They may be partners, employees or even well-wishers. The work you do in the office will satisfy you. Get your priorities sorted and work in the direction of your goal, suggests Ganesha.

Ganesha advises you to watch your back today. However, he wants to make it clear that you may be at the receiving end of others’ actions. Anyway, your cautious and watchful approach will save you from needless discomfiture. In short, life will teach you priceless and precious lessons today, predicts Ganesha. You should face life as it comes and should try maintaining good relations with your spouse. Your soft corner may help your partner get closer to you. You need to express your emotions and share your sorrows and joys. It would not be difficult for you to understand your beloved. Ganesha feels that today you will be in a mood to do something new. Health will be supportive so you will be able to initiate new things. You may be facing troubles in taking major decisions but it’s a good day to do something creative. This is going to be an extremely lucky day for your money matters. You should try for foreign settlement. If you go for visa, you will get it, feels Ganesha. This is going to be a very favourable day for you. You will get an opportunity to explore your creativity today. You will definitely excel in every field. Your enthusiastic mind will come up with various ideas and this may make it a little difficult to take decisions. You will be lauded for your friendly nature today.

You will be in a light-hearted mood today. Be it at the office or at the home, you will be full of joy and will be looking to pass your time lesiurely. You will spend time with family and friends. You will be unable to implement your plans for tackling work today in your current mood, says Ganesha. Singles may want to spend a quality time on impressing the opposite sex but it might not work. Singles should approach their parents to find the perfect match. However, there is good news for married couples as they will spend a wonderful evening together. Ganesha feels that work front is going to be occupied. As a result, you may feel stressed throughout. Try to maintain good rapport with your colleagues, as you’ll need their support later. Health needs care now. Just keep calm and keep doing your task. The day is not going to be a very favourable day on the financial front, says Ganesha. If possible, avoid investing money today, as you are unlikely to earn money on your investments. You may prefer to remain low profile, even after a cheerful time with your colleagues. You will come across many opportunities to learn some new techniques and foresight. You may even join workshop or seminar secretly. Professionally, you will work on your weak points.

You will be cool as a cucumber today. Nothing that happens will unsettle that composure, says Ganesha. Your loved ones will stand tall and strong behind you, and inspire you to overcome obstacles. Your work will reflect dedication, says Ganesha. Go ahead and ask for work that is intellectually taxing. You may want to please your beloved and to do so you will try to meet all his/her demands. Paying attention to your partner’s feelings won’t be difficult. You may be in a mood to think your way whenever it comes to the relationship. It’s not a bad day for you from health point of view, says Ganesha. You will learn something new which would encourage you. If you maintain your food timings and break timings, you will be able to sail through the day smoothly. If you are in business partnership, keep your business partner in the foreground in financial negotiations, your business will be benefited. If you are married, listen to your spouse’s advise on finances. Things may not work in your luck today although you take actions only after thinking logically about matters. You may need to put in a heck of a lot of effort. Finding a solution to problems won’t be difficult. Keep your head cool and be friendly to everyone.

Letting things build up inside you is never a good idea. Learn from this as there is every possibility that today might turn out to be an aggravating and exasperating day for you. You may feel that way due to all the amassed emotions and resentments, so let it all go. It would be a good idea to take a break from the routine and bring in some freshness. Recharge yourself by indulging in some fun and frolic today, says Ganesha. You will get the much-awaited free time you wanted to spend with your family. This will bring a smile to the face of every family member. You will be able to balance your domestic work and romantic relationship. Both will remain equally important to you. Ganesha feels that it’s an average day for health and related matters. Enthusiasm and confidence level will be very low. To avoid fatigue, you should have food or juices accordingly. Eating lighter food will help you perform well at work. The day is not looking so good for financial planning or financial progress. Your expenses are going to increase. You will spend money behind day to day needs, travel and health issues. It is a perfect day for those involved in technical work. Expect an average day for those with administrative jobs. Your enthusiasm at the workplace will be noteworthy. Ganesha feels that you are ready to learn new things. It’s a good time for welcoming a positive change in the operation.

Today, Ganesha is in the mood to give you health tips. Cultivate healthy eating habits and exercise regularly to stay away from disorders like obesity. Irregular eating habits and unhealthy lifestyle may lead to many other troubles. Eat healthy, stay happy. Your possessiveness in love is encouraged as long as it is liked by your sweetheart. However, you should keep patience and your emotional stability should be high. It’s the time to understand your sweetheart and relate strongly. Proper eye contact will enhance your loyalty and faithfulness. Try to do some creative work as it will help to overpower your sensitive mood today. Health may need your attention now, hence Ganesha suggets you to avoid all junk food and plan some balanced diet for yourself now. Today is a good day to invest money keeping in mind the future security of your family, such as setting aside a good chunk of reserves for the higher education of your children. You may wish to implement new ideas in the workplace. This is the best opportunity to start off new projects as anything begun today will progress rapidly. You will get enough financial support. If you are working on any technological project, Ganesha says that this is the right time to expand.

You have been experiencing the adverse effects of stressful lifestyle off-late. But not anymore, as you realise the importance of good health. Maintaining good health will begin with good news of either promotion or increment at work. This leaves you happy and satisfied, says Ganesha. You will succeed in pleasing your partner. Romantic life will be full of pleasure and satisfaction. Your partner will give you the emotional support. You will be great in managing your energy and emotion. Presenting a gift or taking your honey to a foreign place would be in your mind. You may feel low today. You may take things to the heart. You are suggested not to allow your emotions come out as they could come out in a wrong way. You are also suggested not to do any task that’s stressful for you. There will be very good opportunity to buy nice house or car – coming your way. Don’t miss out on it, says Ganesha. By and large, the day is looking fabulous for financial matters. A phone call from home may distract you at work, says Ganesha. Your responsibilities towards your family may keep bothering you and it may be difficult for you to focus on work. Eventually, you may lose your temper. High time to check your emotion.

It may seem too far-fetched, but your boss will bank on your brilliance and unmatched abilities to get respite from the existing problems, says Ganesha. Moreover, much to the dismay of your rivals, you will have your way and gain popularity by winning the hearts of your clients. While spending time with your beloved, you may share certain experience that were, until now, locked up inside you. Evening time will be reserved for some serious talks with your companion about the level of commitment in personal life. You may indulge in music and prove your talent in front of your sweetheart. Ganesha says that good time will come once you will show faith and sympathy. Ganesha foresees, your health to be fine now. Try to think about your various sides of matter. keep a check on your mood swings and think more logically about matters. This seems a good day to plan a short distance trip to rejuvenate with your loved ones. If any of your relatives need money, Ganesha advises you not to hesitate in lending it to them as the planets suggest that they will return it in time. You might want to blow up your money on a little family pleasure trip. Giving your completed project one last look will not be harmful. In fact, you may find some minor mistakes and rectify them. This may even help you in deciding future plans. You should be more dedicated to working on the most important tasks.

Eat, drink, and make merry. But watch out: don’t empty your pockets in one go. Also, guard your reputation. A lot depends on your behaviour, and the big daddies may be watching you. You have a lot at stake, and there should be no regrets later. Let success be your priority for now, says Ganesha. All else will follow. It’s going to be one of the most memorable romantic nights. You will welcome a few changes. Adjustments will be the key to ensuring a happy love life. Managing emotional issues will be easy once you will get the support from your loved one. Ganesha finds, this day to be favorable for you as you are not going to face any health problem today. Majority of the tasks delegated to you will be need based. Hence its advisable to not take initiatives at work now. Ganesha advises you to have regard for the concerns of others, especially in matters of finances, and lend a helping hand whenever possible. This will help fetch you a lot of goodwill and blessings. You like things to go according to your plan. However, today you may have to compromise on a few things and finish the designated work in the allotted time. You may not like the pressure, but take it as a challenge and try to handle it successfully, suggests Ganesha.

You will feel very emotional about those who are close to your heart. Those people who know you will endear you because of this quality of yours. But Ganesha adds a word of caution; take care of those people whom you hold close to your heart because in your sentiments for them you might not notice their bad qualities or forgive their mistakes. You might feel fastidious today and spend time to groom yourself in a saloon or beauty parlour. Your emotional attachment to your partner will make you successfully balance profession and personal life. You want to be special in the eyes of your beloved and never want to stay away from romantic moments. Your imagination will help you drive crazily for your sweetheart. You may give up a lot of time for others. As a result you’ll feel satisfied today. Avoid getting to much sensitive as it may affect your health. Ganesha advises you to maintain proper water level in body as it will leave good impact on your health. Today is a good day to earn goodwill by helping your friends, especially in financial matters. Ganesha feels that you will be ready to do it. However, ensure that people do not take you for a ride. It is time to breathe a new life into yourself. You may think of being innovative in your work but confusions about the right and wrong thing will stop you from doing so. The dilemma will be solved in a day or two, feels Ganesha.
